canonical_definition: MathVista is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate mathematical reasoning in visual contexts, structured primarily as visual question answering (VQA). It assesses a model's ability to integrate mathematical computation and visual understanding across diverse problem types, with some papers specifying its focus on seven distinct ability categories or minimal visual dependence in certain tasks. The benchmark includes variants such as testmini subsets and supports evaluations in both zero-shot and standard fine-tuning settings, often serving as a standardized tool for comparing vision-language models' math reasoning capabilities.
